title: Count transitions by the rollout length and accept word values in reward options
summary: Native training recorded transitions as update x 24 x robots whatever --steps-per-env selected, so metrics rows, state and checkpoint sidecars understated longer rollouts: the 2500-update, 48-control run recorded 7,680,000 transitions and collected 15,360,000. Training now counts update x the configured rollout x robots. native_results.json states each run's collected count beside the recorded one. locomotion.prepare's reward-option check accepted numeric values alone and refused yaw_gate_on=none and yaw_gate_on=all; it now accepts lowercase words and checks every key and value against the selected task's reward configuration, as the trainer does, so plain v4 still refuses schedule_weight=none.
next: Results records of runs trained from 1b4d67a1 or 55bfbe7f with another rollout length state the collected transition count.
reason: The fix corrects a recorded count and an option check; it changes no reward, gate or result verdict.
